current_state: The repo has separate fixture corpora for effect execution, delegated authority, and release assurance, but no single operator-readable path stitches them into one story that an external reviewer can run and understand in one sitting.

The demo outputs typed artifacts, not prose-only claims.

title: Ship the benchmark / forge-bench proof package
current_state: The architecture is now internally consistent, but there is still no external score sheet that proves superiority on replayable evidence-bound reasoning, temporal correctness, contradiction handling, and verification yield.
required_change: Define the benchmark suite, publish fixture inputs and expected outputs, and add one reproducible score sheet. The benchmark must target what ordinary RAG or generic agent stacks cannot do: replayability, temporal correctness, widening disclosure, and repair honesty.
acceptance: 11_BENCHMARK_PLAN.md is implemented as runnable benchmark assets, not just aspirations.
A score sheet compares the stack against at least one weaker baseline on temporal correctness and replayability.
Benchmark artifacts are stored under contracts/fixtures/bench or docs/benchmarks with a reproducibility note.
